title: STEdgeFormer: MCU and NPU Deployable Transformer Architecture
abstract: arXiv:2611.28935v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Transformer-based sequence models have achieved strong performance in language and time-series modeling, but self-attention remains computationally and memory intensive for deployment on resource-constrained edge accelerators. We propose STEdgeFormer, a lightweight, hardware-aware sequence architecture designed for efficient execution on embedded neural accelerators. STEdgeFormer combines polynomial mixture layers and DyT normalization with an accelerator-aware causal memory block, replacing pairwise self-attention with compact causal aggregation. On TinyStories, the fully NPU-supported STEdgeFormer (MW) achieves a perplexity of 7.39 with 4.12M parameters and 6.51 MB RAM, with an end-to-end latency of 40 ms. In comparison, the standard 4.12M-parameter configuration achieves a lower perplexity of 6.79 but requires CPU fallback for unsupported operators, resulting in 1450 ms latency. translated_abstract: 基于Transformer的序列模型在语言和时间序列建模中取得了出色的性能，但自注意力机制在计算和内存方面的开销较大，难以部署在资源受限的边缘加速器上。我们提出了STEdgeFormer，这是一种轻量级、硬件感知的序列架构，专为在嵌入式神经加速器上高效执行而设计。STEdgeFormer将多项式混合层和DyT归一化与加速器感知的因果记忆块相结合，用紧凑的因果聚合取代了成对自注意力机制。在TinyStories数据集上，完全支持NPU的STEdgeFormer（MW）版本在4.12M参数量和6.51 MB内存的条件下实现了7.39的困惑度，端到端延迟仅为40毫秒。相比之下，标准的4.12M参数配置虽然取得了更低的困惑度6.79，但由于存在不支持的算子需要CPU回退，导致延迟高达1450毫秒。而原始Transformer则达到了困惑度……
tldr: 本文提出轻量级硬件感知架构STEdgeFormer，用多项式混合层、DyT归一化和加速器感知的因果记忆块取代自注意力机制，使模型可完全部署在NPU上，在TinyStories上以40毫秒延迟和6.51 MB内存实现7.39困惑度，远优于需CPU回退的标准配置的1450毫秒延迟。
en_tdlr: STEdgeFormer is a lightweight hardware-aware sequence architecture that replaces pairwise self-attention with polynomial mixture layers, DyT normalization, and an accelerator-aware causal memory block, enabling full NPU deployment on edge devices with 40 ms latency and 6.51 MB RAM while achieving a perplexity of 7.39 on TinyStories, vastly outperforming the standard configuration that suffers 1450 ms latency due to CPU fallback.
